attrs.gap: The algebra is implemented and property-tested rather than cited: scripts/emb-support.mjs §3 draws random monotone functions over universes of 2 to 5 artifacts and checks that the minimal transversals of the kernel family are exactly the prime implicants of the dual, that removing a cut destroys recoverability, and that no proper subset of a cut is a cut. NOTE THE EVIDENCE TYPE, which is the reason this record is OPEN and not PROVED: 400 draws is a randomized search. It corroborates the identity for this implementation and enumerates nothing, and by this ledger's own rules it cannot carry a universal — the same rule that retyped INS-KERNEL-LAWS at R5.1. Enumeration is output-exponential in general; Fredman & Khachiyan give an incremental quasi-polynomial algorithm for transversal generation and the exact complexity of monotone dualization is open. The worked example — a capability recoverable from A alone or from B and C together, with cuts {A,B} and {A,C} — shows the shape that matters: a revocation plan that deletes the artifact the capability "came from" and stops has revoked nothing.

attrs.statement: Continuity kernels are the prime implicants of the capability-support function and minimal revocation cuts are the minimal transversals of that family.
